source.timestamp_convention: scene start UTC parsed from the NOAA filename

temporal_alignment.selection: latest scene whose start timestamp is at or before the radar window start
temporal_alignment.causality: A scene newer than the radar window start is never selected. Temporal derivatives are not part of v1.

target_grid.projection: AEQD spherical centred at the Sumaré radar

normalization.rationale: ABI infrared CMI is stored as brightness temperature in kelvin. This fixed physical scale avoids fitting statistics on validation or test years; a train-only standardization may be added in a later version.
